guide_zh.overview: Google Workspace CLI — one command-line tool for Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Chat, Admin, and more. Dynamically built from Google Discovery Service. Includes AI agent skills.

readme.markdown:
**One CLI for all of Google Workspace — built for humans and AI agents.** Drive, Gmail, Calendar, and every Workspace API. Zero boilerplate. Structured JSON output. 40+ agent skills included.

> [!NOTE] > This is **not** an officially supported Google product.
